entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, I'm certainly sorry to hear that. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The thing is broken.
I see. And what specifically seems to be the problem? For example, will it not turn on, or won't it sync with the app?
It won't sync reliably, and the pulse tracking feature is completely defective. For what I paid, I expect it to work.

I completely understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your account with your phone number... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It was delivered on December 15th, so about 39 days ago.

Well, the good news is you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. Since you're reporting the item is defective, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Fine. About time something was simple.

Of course. I am processing that for you now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, and drop it in the mail.
The email has just been sent. You should see it within the next few minutes. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could help with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
